column1: # PrivacySense Matter Room Hub - Partition Table
# See docs/ota-safety.md section 5.1 for the frozen draft.
#   - Two equal OTA slots sizes (5 MB each); max image must fit in one slot.
#   - coredump stored on flash for post-mortem analysis.
#   - Business config (ps_cfg) in a SEPARATE NVS partition so that corruption
#     of the default `nvs` partition (Wi-Fi/Matter/BLE credentials) can be
#     erased and recovered WITHOUT losing business config. See
#   - Remaining space (~5.75 MB) reserved for future local storage.
# SubType: ota_0=0x10 / ota_1=0x11 / nvs=0x02 / phy=0x01 / ota=0x00 / coredump=0x03
